\item[Filter emulation]  \emph{Default:} on. {\footnotesize\texttt{zxtune.core.sid.filter}}
\item[MOS6581 filter preset]  \emph{Choices:} Custom, JSIDPlay2 reSID: Lightest, JSIDPlay2 reSID: Lighter, JSIDPlay2 reSID: Light, JSIDPlay2 reSID: Average, JSIDPlay2 reSID: Dark, JSIDPlay2 reSID: Darker, JSIDPlay2 reSID: Darkest, VICE default (reSID bias +500 mV), ReSID 6581 (resid-fp fit), Alankila 6581R4AR 3789, Alankila 6581R3 3984 \#1, Alankila 6581R3 3984 \#2, Lord Nightmare 6581R3 4285, Lord Nightmare 6581R3 4485, Lord Nightmare 6581R4 1986S, ZrX 6581R3 0384, ZrX 6581R3 1984, ZrX 6581R3 3684, ZrX 6581R3 3985, ZrX 6581R4AR 2286, Trurl 6581R3 0784, Trurl 6581R3 0486S, Trurl 6581R3 3384, Trurl 6581R3 4885, Trurl 6581R4AR 3789, Trurl 6581R4AR 4486, Nata 6581R3 2083, Grue 6581R4AR 3488, KruLLo, Enigma 6581R3 4885, Enigma 6581R3 1585. \emph{Default:} Custom. {\footnotesize\texttt{zxtune.core.sid.filter\_6581\_preset}}
\item[MOS8580 filter preset]  \emph{Choices:} Custom, JSIDPlay2 reSID: Light, JSIDPlay2 reSID: Average, JSIDPlay2 reSID: Dark, Trurl 8580R5 1489, Trurl 8580R5 3691. \emph{Default:} Custom. {\footnotesize\texttt{zxtune.core.sid.filter\_8580\_preset}}
\item[Filter cutoff curve]  {\footnotesize\texttt{ui.sid.filter\_curve}}
\item[MOS8580 digi boost] MOS8580 only: make samples played via volume register audible \emph{Default:} off. {\footnotesize\texttt{zxtune.core.sid.digiboost}}
\item[reSID: MOS6581 filter bias] reSID engine, MOS6581 custom filter only: shifts filter cutoff frequency mapping (range: -1000 mV to 1000 mV) \emph{Default:} 0 mV. {\footnotesize\texttt{zxtune.core.sid.filter\_bias}}
\item[reSIDfp: MOS6581 filter curve] reSIDfp engine, custom filter only: 0 - light, 100 - dark \emph{Default:} 50. {\footnotesize\texttt{zxtune.core.sid.filter\_6581\_curve}}
\item[reSIDfp: MOS6581 filter range] reSIDfp engine, custom filter only: 0 - dark, 100 - light \emph{Default:} 50. {\footnotesize\texttt{zxtune.core.sid.filter\_6581\_range}}
\item[reSIDfp: MOS8580 filter curve] reSIDfp engine, custom filter only: 0 - light, 100 - dark \emph{Default:} 50. {\footnotesize\texttt{zxtune.core.sid.filter\_8580\_curve}}
\item[reSIDfp: combined waveforms]  \emph{Choices:} Average, Weak, Strong. \emph{Default:} Average. {\footnotesize\texttt{zxtune.core.sid.combined\_waveforms}}
\item[6581 pulse+saw (reSIDfp)]  \emph{Choices:} Normal (most 6581 chips), Strong (chips with loud pulse+saw). \emph{Default:} Normal (most 6581 chips). {\footnotesize\texttt{zxtune.core.sid.strong\_pulse\_saw}}
\item[2SID/3SID output]  \emph{Choices:} Stereo (chips panned), Mono. \emph{Default:} Stereo (chips panned). {\footnotesize\texttt{zxtune.core.sid.multi\_sid\_mono}}

\section{Oscilloscope}
\subsection*{Display}
\begin{description}
\item[Waveforms window] Displayed duration of each voice waveform (range: 5 ms to 100 ms) \emph{Default:} 40 ms. {\footnotesize\texttt{ui.oscilloscope.window\_ms}}
\item[Visual amplification]  \emph{Choices:} Automatic (per voice), $\times$1, $\times$1.5, $\times$2, $\times$3, $\times$4, $\times$6, $\times$8. \emph{Default:} Automatic (per voice). {\footnotesize\texttt{ui.oscilloscope.gain}}
\item[Max periods shown (zoom on high notes)]  \emph{Choices:} Off (whole window), 4 periods, 8 periods, 16 periods, 32 periods. \emph{Default:} 8 periods. {\footnotesize\texttt{zxtune.sound.scope.max\_periods}}
\item[SID gauges window] Displayed duration of oscillators and master volume gauges (range: 2 ms to 40 ms) \emph{Default:} 10 ms. {\footnotesize\texttt{ui.oscilloscope.gauge\_window\_ms}}
\item[Oscilloscope height] Relative to 16:9 of width, the dashboard below takes the rest of screen (range: 60\% to 160\%) \emph{Default:} 100\%. {\footnotesize\texttt{ui.oscilloscope.height}}
\item[Filter response height] Part of oscilloscope taken by SID filter response above voices waveforms (range: 20\% to 80\%) \emph{Default:} 55\%. {\footnotesize\texttt{ui.oscilloscope.filter\_share}}
\item[AdLib rhythm lanes] OPL/OPL2: lanes of drums of rhythm mode (most of tunes don't use it), else 9 voices in 3$\times$3. Applied from the next track \emph{Default:} off. {\footnotesize\texttt{ui.oscilloscope.opl\_rhythm}}
\item[Waveforms under filter response] SID filter view shows response curve above voices waveforms, else response only \emph{Default:} on. {\footnotesize\texttt{ui.oscilloscope.filter\_waves}}
\item[Show technical statistics] Scope, sound output, rendering and GPU lines below the dashboard \emph{Default:} on. {\footnotesize\texttt{ui.oscilloscope.show\_stats}}
\item[Frame rate limit]  \emph{Choices:} Display refresh rate, 120 fps, 90 fps, 60 fps, 30 fps. \emph{Default:} Display refresh rate. {\footnotesize\texttt{ui.oscilloscope.max\_fps}}
\item[Graphics backend]  \emph{Choices:} Automatic (Vulkan if available), Vulkan, OpenGL ES. \emph{Default:} Automatic (Vulkan if available). {\footnotesize\texttt{ui.oscilloscope.backend}}
\item[Custom Vulkan driver] Select driver package (zip with meta.json or .so library, e.g. Mesa Turnip for Adreno GPUs) {\footnotesize\texttt{ui.oscilloscope.vulkan\_driver}}
\item[Use custom Vulkan driver] System driver is used if custom one fails to load \emph{Default:} off. {\footnotesize\texttt{ui.oscilloscope.vulkan\_driver.enabled}}
\end{description}
\subsection*{Trigger}
\begin{description}
\item[Preset]  \emph{Choices:} Default (corrscope template, 40 ms), Evolving notes (60 ms), Chiptune square/pulse, Bass, low notes, NES triangle, Power saving, Custom. \emph{Default:} Default (corrscope template, 40 ms). {\footnotesize\texttt{ui.oscilloscope.trigger\_preset}}
\item[Trigger width] History buffer size, should exceed two periods of the lowest notes (range: 10 ms to 200 ms) \emph{Default:} 40 ms. {\footnotesize\texttt{zxtune.sound.scope.trigger.width}}
\item[Edge strength] Prefer steep rising edges: new notes are caught better, but sustained ones jump more (range: 0\% to 300\%) \emph{Default:} 100\%. {\footnotesize\texttt{zxtune.sound.scope.trigger.edge\_strength}}
\item[Slope width] (range: 5\% of period to 100\% of period) \emph{Default:} 25\% of period. {\footnotesize\texttt{zxtune.sound.scope.trigger.slope\_width}}
\item[Buffer strength] Prefer similarity with previous frames (range: 0\% to 300\%) \emph{Default:} 100\%. {\footnotesize\texttt{zxtune.sound.scope.trigger.buffer\_strength}}
\item[Buffer responsiveness] (range: 0\% to 100\%) \emph{Default:} 50\%. {\footnotesize\texttt{zxtune.sound.scope.trigger.responsiveness}}
\item[Buffer falloff] (range: 10\% of period to 200\% of period) \emph{Default:} 50\% of period. {\footnotesize\texttt{zxtune.sound.scope.trigger.buffer\_falloff}}
\item[Reset below match] Forget history on new notes when wave doesn't match it (range: 0\% to 100\%) \emph{Default:} 30\%. {\footnotesize\texttt{zxtune.sound.scope.trigger.reset\_below}}
\item[DC removal rate] (range: 0\% to 100\%) \emph{Default:} 0\%. {\footnotesize\texttt{zxtune.sound.scope.trigger.mean\_responsiveness}}
\item[Sign amplification] Steep zero crossings for waves without clear edges (e.g. triangle) (range: 0\% to 300\%) \emph{Default:} 0\%. {\footnotesize\texttt{zxtune.sound.scope.trigger.sign\_strength}}
\item[Search range] (range: 10\% of width to 100\% of width) \emph{Default:} 50\% of width. {\footnotesize\texttt{zxtune.sound.scope.trigger.diameter}}
\item[Falling edges] E.g. for sampled trumpets \emph{Default:} off. {\footnotesize\texttt{zxtune.sound.scope.trigger.falling}}
\item[Pitch tracking] Rescale history on pitch changes \emph{Default:} on. {\footnotesize\texttt{zxtune.sound.scope.trigger.pitch\_tracking}}
\item[Zero crossing post trigger, samples] Slide to the nearest rising zero crossing, 0 to disable \emph{Default:} 0. {\footnotesize\texttt{zxtune.sound.scope.trigger.post\_radius}}
\item[Full searches]  \emph{Choices:} Every frame, 60 per second, 30 per second. \emph{Default:} Every frame. {\footnotesize\texttt{zxtune.sound.scope.trigger.search\_rate}}
\item[Trigger subsampling]  \emph{Choices:} Automatic, None (full rate), 2, 4. \emph{Default:} Automatic. {\footnotesize\texttt{zxtune.sound.scope.trigger.subsampling}}
\end{description}
